label: The Day of the Real Test

lines.text: ... Sometime later.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: ... Owls, listen up.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: From now on, actual training on the surface will begin.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: The objective of this operation is to survive in the lab.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Currently, there are 6 drones that will be monitoring you.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: The video feed will be watched in real-time by the commander and myself in the temporary camp.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Our boss, Ingrid, will be watching from the Ark.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Even if your life is in danger, we will not intervene.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: ... To be exact, those who are not good enough to survive will be left to die.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: So, use everything you've got for the next 3 hours... That's it.
Do you think the Owls will be able to pull it off?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Don't ask the obvious.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: We've calculated all the variables from plan A to C.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: If they can't survive, then that makes them trash. They'd be fit for Rapture food.
... 1 hour later. Instructor's Camp.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: So far it's going as planned.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: They've encountered 10 Raptures so far,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: and the Owls' average damage is at 9%.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: If we continue this way, we can all survive without any problems.
... 1 hour later. Instructor's Camp.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: ... Hmm.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: This is starting to get a bit boring.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Maybe I underestimated the Owl's skills.
30 minutes before the end of live training, Instructor's Camp.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: ... Weakling.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Come here.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: That black thing under the iron plate where they are standing on.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: What do you think that is?
It looks like a big blade.
It looks like a leg of a Rapture.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: You saw it right.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: ... That is a Lord-class Rapture.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: It's not supposed to be in a place like this but I think it caught the scent of the Owls and came.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: ... If only we had an operator, we would have dealt with it earlier. Damn those Central Government bastards. It looks like things will get a bit bumpy.
Do you think the Owls will be able to fight it?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Are you kidding me?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: If the freshly manufactured Owls are able to defeat a Lord-class,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: we would have already recaptured the surface...
*Crash*

lines.speaker: owls
lines.text: Aaaaaaah!!

lines.speaker: grayowl
lines.text: Blue Owl!

lines.speaker: grayowl
lines.text: From the intel we received, was there anything on how to deal with this situation?

lines.speaker: blueowl
lines.text: Not for a Lord-class... there was no mention at all!
*Whoosh*

lines.speaker: purpleowl
lines.text: Aaaaaah! M-my arm!

lines.speaker: redowl
lines.text: I-Instructor, Assistant Instructor! Are you there?

lines.speaker: redowl
lines.text: Please save us, please.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: ... Damn.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Making it difficult until the very end.
Let's save them.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: ... Don't bring up such nonsense.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Maybe we can provide verbal instructions,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: but as soon as we enter that area, the Owls will be disqualified.
That's more than enough.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: What? Explain so I can understand.
If we can't enter,
then we'll command the Owls to lead the enemy out of the field.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: ... I see.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: The distance between the institute and the Instructor's Camp is only 450 meters.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: As soon as the lord class is out of the field, I can shoot it down.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: ... But the only problem is the view.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: All the six drones are fixed on the Owls.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: If we are sending an order that's far away, at least half of them have to be manipulated to secure the view.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Is there someone who can manage that...
I can do it.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: ... What?
During my time at the military academy, I learned it during culture class.
So you take the lead.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: you're leaving the field command to me and you would rather take a step back?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I have seen a lot of weaklings but you are something else.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: unlike the others, it is a great decision.
Eunhwa mightily grabs the mic.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: ... Owls.

lines.speaker: yellowowl
lines.text: Uhh... Uh huh... Instructor...

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Stop your crying.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: From now on you will do as I tell you.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: If you want to live, you will follow my orders without any mistakes.

lines.speaker: owls
lines.text: ... Yes, Instructor!!

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: ... Weakling.  Have you manipulated the drones yet?
... Where should I move drone number one?
The second floor of the laboratory.
Where the Raptures are concentrated.
The drone was sent over the emergency stairs.
On the screen, about 10 Raptures are seen.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: ... Are they an energy type Rapture?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Let's use that.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Red Owl, shoot the ceiling.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Yellow Owl, release the decoys to the bottom.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: The rest of you, split up.

lines.speaker: owls
lines.text: Yes, Instructor!
*Rat-tat-tat-tat-tat*
As the ceiling collapses and the energy type Raptures fall down
The lord class that was lured by the decoy gets hit by a beam cannon and explodes loudly.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: ... We just bought ourselves 10 seconds.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Weakling. Let's see another view.
Where should I move drone number two?
The Laboratory entrance.
The Laboratory front windows.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: ... Is this a time to enjoy the outdoor view?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Look for places that are more strategically useful.
The drone moves to the Laboratory entrance.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: ... Is this the entrance closest to the Instructor's Camp?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: 7 o'clock, distance 90 meters away, 23 Raptures are seen along the way.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: ... Good. I see the path.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Yellow Owl, lay the mines over the coordinate I'm going to send.

lines.speaker: yellowowl
lines.text: Yes, yes Instructor!!

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Blue Owl, move to the second floor.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Take a sniper position and cover Yellow Owl.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: White Owl, you stand guard at the landing.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Don't let a single Rapture come up.

lines.speaker: owls
lines.text: Affirmative, Instructor!

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Weakling, next!
Where should I move the third drone?
To the Lord-class Rapture.
... The Lord-class Rapture is aggressively chasing the Owls.
Whenever it tries to deviate from the path,
the mine explodes and cuts off its path.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_op
lines.text: The remaining distance is approximately 30 meters... 10 meters...
*Beep*

lines.speaker: eunhwa_op
lines.text: Done!

lines.speaker: eunhwa_op
lines.text: It's outside!

lines.speaker: yellowowl
lines.text: I-Instructor! The Rapture...

lines.speaker: yellowowl
lines.text: is heading straight to the Instructor's Camp!!

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: It doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I've already marked it as my target.
*Bang*
As the sparks flash from Eunhwa's muzzle,
a huge explosion engulfs the Lord-class Rapture.

lines.speaker: yellowowl
lines.text: L-lord-class Rapture.

lines.speaker: yellowowl
lines.text: All clear.
*Beep*

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: ... The countdown appears to be over.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Owls, the real test is over.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: ... No. Should I call you full-fledged Nikkes now?
Did you hear everything from the start?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: I was keeping quiet to observe how you two would deal with an unexpected situation like this.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: ... All in all, Eunhwa, {AccountData.NickName}, you both worked really well.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Your accomplishments will be acknowledged in the Ark.
Ingrid cuts off communication.

lines.speaker: yellowowl
lines.text: ... Thank you for your hard work, Instructor...

lines.speaker: redowl
lines.text: Assistant Instructor as well!

lines.speaker: purpleowl
lines.text: Thank you so much for your help.

lines.speaker: purpleowl
lines.text: During the briefing, you said there will be no help... *Sob*

lines.speaker: purpleowl
lines.text: I thought we were surely done for...

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: ... Were you all daydreaming? Idiots.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I didn't help you.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: The Lord-class was crawling outside, so I had to destroy it as a defensive measure.

lines.speaker: purpleowl
lines.text: ... Uh, what?
Meaning you should testify like that if someone asks you.
In principle, we did something that we shouldn't have done.

lines.speaker: owls
lines.text: Ah...
The Owls exchange glances for a moment.

lines.speaker: blueowl
lines.text: ... I understand what you mean.

lines.speaker: blueowl
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: blueowl
lines.text: ... Even if you say it never happened, we will never forget this.

lines.speaker: blueowl
lines.text: Instructor, thank you for the past three days.
The trainees all bowed their heads 90 degrees in respect.

lines.speaker: redowl
lines.text: H-hey, Instructor...!

lines.speaker: redowl
lines.text: May I say hello if I see you again during our missions?

lines.speaker: redowl
lines.text: Or can we at least send you a letter...!!

lines.speaker: grayowl
lines.text: I think she'd really hate that. You know the Instructor's personality.

lines.speaker: grayowl
lines.text: I'm sure they'd frown and tell you to get lost.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Shut up.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: If you have time to talk nonsense, go back to the Ark and replace your ragged arms and legs.

lines.speaker: grayowl
lines.text: Instructor, do you have any objections?

lines.speaker: redowl
lines.text: Haha... Even now you are worried about us, right?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: ... Bunch of loudmouths.
... Sometime later. Elevator in the Ark.

lines.speaker: yellowowl
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: yellowowl
lines.text: The instructors aren't coming down with us?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: ... Assistant instructor, I have someplace to go.

lines.speaker: grayowl
lines.text: Is it a mission?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: It's a personal matter.

lines.speaker: grayowl
lines.text: Come back safe.

lines.speaker: grayowl
lines.text: ... Well, since it's Instructor Eunhwa, I'm sure there will be no issues.

lines.speaker: redowl
lines.text: Instructor, we will write you letters! Please read them!
Sometime later. The elevator door closes.
... Where are you going?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Just shut up and follow me.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Don't ask any questions.
